item.title: Ryan Berg in Foreign Policy: Trump’s Western Hemisphere Pivot Is Real
item.description: Americas Program Director Ryan C. Berg contends that if President Trump wants to make good on the new National Security Strategy, the United States must recalibrate its defense posture.

item.title: The Pentagon’s AI Problem Isn’t Algorithms, It’s Evaluation
item.description: Current AI benchmarks were not designed for the realities of war. Without defense-specific evaluation, AI systems risk being deployed without evidence they improve military judgment or outcomes.

item.title: Back in Play: U.S.-India Nuclear Partnership Finds a New Opening
item.description: India’s new nuclear law reopens the door to U.S.–India nuclear cooperation by fixing liability and opening the sector to private players—but whether this sparks real investment or remains a symbolic reset will hinge on regulation, costs, and realistic targets.

item.title: Which U.S. Government Agencies Are Facilitating the Trump Administration’s Commercial Diplomacy in Africa?
item.description: President Trump’s formal approach to Africa is centered on “trade, not aid,” which has shifted the agencies and organizations responsible for facilitating the United States’ engagement with Africa.

item.title: China’s Third Policy Paper on Latin America and the Caribbean: Expanding Influence and Ambitions
item.description: China’s third policy paper on Latin America and the Caribbean outlines an institutionalized strategy to deepen regional engagement and secure support for Beijing’s geopolitical goals, with significant implications for U.S. policy in the region and for Taiwan.

item.title: What the New National Security Strategy Means for Naval Forces
item.description: The 2025 National Security Strategy recasts naval power as an economic and industrial instrument, pushing the Navy toward unmanned systems, hemispheric missions, and more cost-effective approaches to deterring China.

item.title: Ryan Berg in Americas Quarterly: A Roadmap for Venezuela’s Future Transition
item.description: Americas Program Director Ryan C. Berg argues that following a transition, the United States must continue humanitarian aid, investment, and renewed diplomatic efforts to ensure the delivery of essential services and support a free Venezuela.
